name: bindtopia
description: Free, ad-free fan-made Pokémon card catalog: search, local photo recognition, local collection, release years, card text and price indications.

scripts.check: node --check dist/app.mjs && node scripts/check.mjs && node scripts/check-i18n.mjs && node scripts/check-sync.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs
